import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] a = new long[17];

    static long compute(long n, int i) {
        long quotient = n / a[i];
        n %= a[i];
        if (n == 0) return quotient * i;
        else return quotient * i + Math.min(i + compute(a[i] - n, i - 1), compute(n, i - 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        a[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 16; i++) {
            a[i] = a[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(compute(n, 16));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
